realBrides.robeWorn: Amanda 3D Petals Robe (Bride) & HALO Robes in Warm Champagne (10 Bridesmaids)
realBrides.quote: Putting on the Amanda 3D petals robe with all ten of my best friends in their champagne HALO robes was the most emotional half hour of my entire wedding day. Lariel set the tone for royalty before I even touched my wedding dress.

realBrides.robeWorn: Adire Royal Heritage Robe in Indigo & Pure Gold
realBrides.quote: I wanted my traditional Yoruba wedding morning to feel deeply rooted yet effortlessly cosmopolitan. The silk Adire robe felt sacred. The weight of the silk and the handmade indigo motifs took everyone’s breath away.

realBrides.robeWorn: Evelyn Silk Robe with Sculpted Underbust Corset Band
realBrides.quote: The sculpted underbust corset gave me the most regal silhouette with my emerald Gele. It was the perfect bridge between ancestral grandeur and contemporary haute couture.

realBrides.robeWorn: Bespoke Hand-Beaded Corset Robe with Sweeping Cape
realBrides.quote: Working 1-on-1 with the Lariel team to incorporate custom seed pearls matching my mother’s vintage jewelry was an unforgettable experience. Truly world-class bridal couture.

realBrides.robeWorn: Sage Green Short Silk PJ Sets (Bridesmaids) & White Lace Robe (Bride)
realBrides.quote: The quality of the ruffle details and the matching inner slips were sensational. My girls danced for 2 hours before we even started hair and makeup. Unmatched energy.

realBrides.robeWorn: Amanda 3D Petals Robe in Pure White
realBrides.quote: The 3D organza petals catch the morning light so ethereally. Everyone in my bridal suite gasped when I stepped out onto the balcony.
